summary_en: Wel-Dish corrected its September 2025 announcement regarding the acquisition of IMG Holdings. The correction clarifies the shareholder composition of IMG Holdings, which had undergone a temporary share transfer prior to the planned stock exchange, restoring the original ownership structure by September 1, 2025.
title_en: Correction to "Notice of Execution of Basic Agreement toward Complete Subsidiary Status of IMG Holdings Inc."
translation_en_brief:
Wel-Dish issued a correction notice on November 10, 2026, to its September 10, 2025 announcement regarding the execution of a basic agreement for the complete subsidiary acquisition of IMG Holdings Inc. The correction addresses the shareholder composition of IMG Holdings.

According to an independent investigative committee's final report released on August 10, 2026, IMG Holdings shares had undergone a temporary share transfer prior to the planned stock exchange. The original announcement had disclosed only the temporary shareholder composition, which differed from the shareholder structure that was scheduled to be restored before the stock exchange completion.

The corrected disclosure now presents the shareholder composition at four different dates: August 1, 2025 (showing the temporary state); September 1, 2025 (after temporary transfer was resolved); September 3, 2025 (further changes); and November 28, 2025 (current state at correction time). This clarifies the actual ownership structure intended for the acquisition.
